title: Luxury Contemporary 2-Storey Residential Duplex & External Works
location: Ado Ekiti & Regional Residential Hubs, Ekiti State
shortDescription: Turnkey architectural and building construction delivery of a luxury 2-storey duplex featuring clean white exterior screeding, architectural parapets, dark shingle roof, cantilevered balcony, and paved grounds.
overview: A modern private residential building construction project showcasing SPES Swiftpace’s craftsmanship. The duplex features contemporary architectural styling, crisp multi-coat exterior screeding, contrasting dark roof tiles, parapet moldings, tinted glazing, cantilevered balcony with accent brick cladding, and paved exterior grounds.
objectives: Deliver a private luxury residence meeting high standards of architectural refinement, structural durability, thermal comfort, and secure perimeter containment.
scopeOfWork: Turnkey building construction from foundation to final finishes, roof framing and dark shingle roofing, electrical and plumbing installations, exterior screeding and painting, and interlocking driveway paving.
technicalApproach: Reinforced concrete frame with sandcrete block infill, waterproofed parapet gutters, tinted exterior glazing, and heavy-duty interlocking concrete compound paving.
projectOutcome: Completed exterior building envelope and compound paving with durable, low-maintenance finishes.
metaDescription: Turnkey architectural planning and building construction of a luxury residential duplex in Ekiti State by SPES Swiftpace.
